verdict.rationale: GitLab's Duo Agent Platform documents custom flows where you "define triggers to control when the flow runs" (gitlab-docs-59), and it offers CI/CD workflow automation (gitlab-docs-8, gitlab-docs-36). That is the product's own mechanism for controlling when workflows execute, but nothing in the pack shows time-based or recurring scheduling. missing for 10: explicit evidence of scheduled/cron-based pipelines or flows, documentation of recurrence configuration, API/CLI control of schedules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
